ideas.name: Drug-Receptor Tug-of-War: Real-Time Dynamic Antagonist Washout
ideas.mechanism: Run a live continuous simulation where the student must continuously pulse agonist molecules to displace competitive antagonists before dissociation kinetics allow rebinding
ideas.expected_effect: Instills a visceral kinetic appreciation of receptor off-rates (koff) and equilibrium dissociation constant thermodynamics
ideas.formatted: Drug-Receptor Tug-of-War: Real-Time Dynamic Antagonist Washout: Run a live continuous simulation where the student must continuously pulse agonist molecules to displace competitive antagonists before dissociation kinetics allow rebinding -> Instills a visceral kinetic appreciation of receptor off-rates (koff) and equilibrium dissociation constant thermodynamics [plausible]

ideas.name: The Corrupt Pharmacopeia: Spotting the Chemically Impossible Molecule
ideas.mechanism: Present four candidate drug structures where one contains a pentavalent nitrogen or chemically impossible esterase-resistant acetal, challenging students to flag the fraud
ideas.expected_effect: Builds vigilance and foundational chemical structural literacy, eliminating uncritical acceptance of drawn chemical diagrams
ideas.formatted: The Corrupt Pharmacopeia: Spotting the Chemically Impossible Molecule: Present four candidate drug structures where one contains a pentavalent nitrogen or chemically impossible esterase-resistant acetal, challenging students to flag the fraud -> Builds vigilance and foundational chemical structural literacy, eliminating uncritical acceptance of drawn chemical diagrams [plausible]

ideas.name: Flash-Forward Case Evolution: Tracking 48 Hours of Receptor Internalization
ideas.mechanism: Allow students to scrub a 48-hour time slider on an asthma patient using continuous high-dose beta-agonist, observing receptor count dwindling from 10,000 to 800 per cell
ideas.expected_effect: Provides dynamic temporal visualization of receptor homeostasis and down-regulation kinetics across multi-day clinical therapy
